tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Wi-Tek WI-PCES318GF V2 16-Port Gigabit Cloud Easy Smart PoE Switch in Bangladesh – D CORE


The Wi-Tek WI-PCES318GF V2 is a high-performance Cloud Easy Smart PoE switch designed for business, surveillance, and enterprise networking solutions. Featuring 16× 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 PoE ports and 2× 1000Mbps SFP uplink ports, this switch ensures stable high-speed connectivity with flexible fiber expansion.


With intelligent cloud management, users can monitor, configure, and manage the network remotely—making it ideal for CCTV systems, office networks, ISPs, and wireless deployments across Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • 16× 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit RJ45 PoE Ports
  • 2× 1000Mbps SFP Uplink Ports
  • Cloud Easy Smart Management
  • IEEE 802.3af/at PoE Support
  • High-Speed Gigabit Data Transfer
  • VLAN, QoS & Network Monitoring Support
  • Durable Metal Housing Design
  • Ideal for CCTV, IP Camera & Wireless AP
